Downloads that JDownloader holds back for a hoster's cool-down keep waiting instead of failing, and every list trembles while you move one of its items.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A download JDownloader holds back for a hoster's cool-down waits instead of failing.** A free 1fichier link can make JDownloader wait several hours between files. KnightLoader took that for a stall after 45 minutes and marked the task as failed, while JDownloader finished the file later without anyone watching. The task shows JDownloader's wait and keeps following it, and a task KnightLoader does give up on is switched off in JDownloader, so the two never disagree. Thanks to [@selioss](https://github.com/selioss) for the careful report with logs in [#155](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/155).
- **A wide column such as Name can be dragged back to either end of the list.** Held at the table's edge, its middle stayed beyond a narrow neighbour's, so it never passed it. A column passes another once its leading edge is past the other's middle.

## 🎨 Design

- **While you hold an item to move it, every other item of the list trembles clearly,** so it is plain at once that they can be moved: the settings rail, the tabs, the overview's cards, the priority card, the download rows and the column heads, and the phone app's lists. Neighbours tremble out of step, and the download rows sway gently, since a full-width row would swing far at its ends. KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.2.5, and the Version card names it.
